items.title: agency-agents

items.title: PMB

items.description: Local-first project memory for AI coding agents so project context does not need to be repeated.
items.angle: PMB 把项目背景做成本地优先的 AI 编码记忆，解决反复解释仓库上下文的问题。
items.voiceover: 第五，PMB，把项目上下文做成本地优先的编码记忆。

items.title: SimFoundry
items.subtitle: HF Paper 2606.28276

items.voiceover: 第六，SimFoundry，自动搭建仿真场景来训练机器人策略。

items.title: HORIZON

items.description: Agentic Hardware Design as Repository-Level Code Evolution treats hardware design as repository-level code evolution.
items.angle: HORIZON 把硬件设计看成仓库级代码演化，让 Agent 在约束、验证和迭代之间推进芯片设计任务。

narration:
